name: Jigsaw Puzzle Table
description: Come enjoy quiet puzzling in the library. A new puzzle is put out every time one is finished, so you never know what you’ll find! For ages 9+.

name: Expo NM Flea Market
description: The largest outdoor flea market on Route 66! Located at Expo New Mexico, our market draws hundreds of vendors and shoppers every Saturday & Sunday, weather permitting. Offering new and used toys, books, tools and more, to custom products, baked goods, candy and produce, the Expo NM Flea Market has something for everyone! Food vendors and live music too. Whether you bike, drive, or take the bus, there are plenty of ways to get to the Market. If you bike, take advantage of the free bike valet service provided by the Raynolds Neighborhood Association, so you can shop hands-free!

name: Genizaros: Indian Captivity in Spanish, Mexican and Early Territorial New Mexico
description: New Mexico State Historian, writer, and researcher Robert J. Torrez reviews the Spanish policy of the rescate , officially sanctioned trade opportunities that enabled and encouraged the purchase, or ransom, of Indian captives and their incorporation into Hispanic society. Subsequent generations of these Indian captives became known as genizaros , Hispanicized Christian Indians that established their own communities and served as stalwart defenders of an embattled New Mexico frontier. Robert J.
